items.title: React List Keys: Keep Edited Text with the Right Record
items.description:
You type a note in the first row of a list. Then you sort the list. The note stays in the first row, but that row now shows a different record.

This can happen when a React list uses its array index as a key. The rows look correct until someone edits a field and changes the order.
